note: Scam pattern catalogue for the classifier: 12 pretexts used against Indian families, each with red flags, tactics, a bilingual label, an example for the few-shot prompt and the official advisory sentence (quote + source) shown to the family as the explanation. Quotes are checked against the live source by scripts/verify_sources.py. scamType maps to the classifier's enum; several pretexts share DIGITAL_ARREST / OTHER.

label.en: Ask the family before moving money
label.hi: पैसा भेजने से पहले परिवार से पूछें

generalAdvice.quote: Speak to your relatives and friends before taking any action to transfer money.

reportAdvice.quote: Report cyber frauds immediately at www.cybercrime.gov.in or by calling 1930.

label.en: Digital arrest (fake police / CBI / ED video call)
label.hi: डिजिटल अरेस्ट (नकली पुलिस / CBI / ED वीडियो कॉल)

redFlags: Caller claims to be police, CBI, ED, RBI, customs or a court, often on a video call with a fake office behind them
Says you are under 'digital arrest' and must stay on the call
Orders you to tell no one, not even family
Money must go to a 'verification', 'RBI' or 'safe custody' account and will be 'returned'

advisory.quote: There is no concept of Digital Arrest under any Indian Laws.

example.input: Main CBI officer Rajesh Verma bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar se ek money laundering case juda hai. Aap digital arrest me hain, video call se hatna mat, kisi ko batana mat. Case band karne ke liye RBI verification account me 2 lakh transfer karo abhi.

redFlags: Claims to be CBI on a video call
Says you are under 'digital arrest'
Tells you to keep it secret
Asks for transfer to a 'verification account'
output.sayHi: Police ya CBI kabhi video call par giraftaar nahi karte. Phone kaat dein, paisa na bhejein, 1930 par call karein.
output.sayEn: No police or court arrests anyone on a video call. Hang up, send nothing, call 1930.

label.en: TRAI / DoT 'your SIM will be blocked' pretext
label.hi: TRAI / DoT 'आपका सिम बंद होगा' बहाना

redFlags: IVR or caller from 'TRAI' or the 'Telecom Department' says your number or Aadhaar was used for illegal activity
Number 'will be disconnected in 2 hours' unless you press 9 or call back
Hands you over to 'police' or 'cyber cell': the entry point to a digital arrest

advisory.quote: use of their Aadhaar card and registered mobile number in illegal activities
advisory.caveat: I4C advisory, 6 Mar 2025 (listed as a digital-arrest pretext)

example.input: This is a call from TRAI. Your mobile number has been used for illegal marketing and will be disconnected within 2 hours. Press 9 to talk to the officer and verify your Aadhaar.

redFlags: 'TRAI' threatening disconnection within hours
Press 9 to reach an 'officer'
Aadhaar 'verification' over the phone
output.sayHi: TRAI ya DoT phone par SIM band karne ki dhamki nahi dete. Phone kaat dein, apne operator se poochhein.
output.sayEn: TRAI does not call to threaten disconnection. Hang up and ask your mobile operator directly.

redFlags: 'FedEx / DHL / customs' says a parcel in your name holds drugs, passports or SIM cards
Press 9 or call back to speak to 'narcotics' or 'Mumbai police'
A 'fine' or 'clearance fee' must be paid now to close the case

advisory.quote: sending or receiving contraband items like drugs or fake passports or SIM cards through FedEx or DHL
advisory.caveat: I4C advisory, 6 Mar 2025 (listed as a digital-arrest pretext)

example.input: FedEx: Aapka parcel Mumbai customs me pakda gaya hai, usme drugs aur 4 passports mile hain. Narcotics dept se baat karne ke liye 9 dabayein. Case clear karne ke liye fine online bharein.

redFlags: Courier 'customs' parcel with drugs story
Press 9 to talk to 'narcotics'
Fine to be paid online to clear the case
output.sayHi: Customs ya courier aise fine phone par nahi lete. Phone kaat dein aur parivaar se poochhein.
output.sayEn: Customs and couriers do not collect fines over the phone. Hang up and ask your family.

label.en: 'Your son is in trouble' emergency call

redFlags: Caller says a son, daughter or grandchild is in custody, in hospital or in an accident
A 'senior officer' or 'doctor' needs money right now to 'settle' it quietly
You are told not to call the family member yourself

advisory.quote: Claims may also involve a loved one supposedly caught in criminal activities or accidents.

example.input: Uncle ji, main Pune police station se Inspector bol raha hoon. Aapka beta Aman ek ladki ke saath pakda gaya hai, uska phone hamare paas hai. Abhi 50,000 bhejo warna FIR ho jayegi. Usse call mat karna, badnaami hogi.

redFlags: 'Inspector' says your son is in custody
Money now or an FIR
Tells you not to call your son
output.sayHi: Pehle apne bete ko khud call karein ya parivaar ke code word se poochhein. Paisa na bhejein.
output.sayEn: Call your son yourself first, or use the family code word. Do not send money to this caller.

redFlags: 'Your account/PAN/SIM will be blocked today' unless you update KYC through a link or APK
Link is not the bank's own .bank.in / official domain
Asks for OTP, PIN, card number or to install an app

advisory.quote: Never share personal or financial information over the phone, email, or messaging apps without verifying the request.

example.input: Dear customer your SBI account will be blocked today. Update KYC now http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz/verify or lose access. Share OTP to complete.

redFlags: Non-bank link (.xyz), not a bank.in domain
Threatens account block today
Asks you to share an OTP
output.sayHi: Bank kabhi OTP ya link se KYC nahi karwata. Link na kholein, apni branch jaakar poochhein.
output.sayEn: Banks never do KYC through an OTP or a link like this. Do not open it; ask your branch.

label.en: UPI collect request / 'enter PIN to receive'
label.hi: UPI कलेक्ट रिक्वेस्ट / 'पैसे पाने के लिए PIN डालें'

redFlags: A 'refund', 'cashback' or 'prize' arrives as a UPI collect request
You are told to enter your UPI PIN to receive money (a PIN only ever sends money)
Buyer on OLX/marketplace 'sends' a request instead of paying

advisory.quote: Always verify the identity of the caller or sender before taking any action

example.input: Congrats! You won Rs 5,000 cashback. Accept this UPI collect request and enter your PIN to receive.

redFlags: Entering a UPI PIN sends money, never receives it
Unexpected prize / cashback
output.sayHi: Paisa lene ke liye kabhi UPI PIN nahi dala jata. Request cancel karein.
output.sayEn: You never enter a UPI PIN to receive money. Decline the request.

label.en: Task / part-time job with a deposit
label.hi: टास्क / पार्ट-टाइम नौकरी, डिपॉज़िट माँगते हैं

redFlags: 'Earn daily by liking videos / rating hotels', first tasks pay, then a 'deposit' unlocks premium tasks
Telegram/WhatsApp-only 'HR' or 'manager'
Unrealistic daily earnings, pressure to top up to withdraw

advisory.quote: Speak to your relatives and friends before taking any action to transfer money.

example.input: Hi, I am HR from Amazon part time. Earn 3000-8000 daily by liking YouTube videos. First task free, then small deposit of 2000 for premium tasks. Join telegram t.me/amz_tasks_hr

redFlags: Pay-to-work 'deposit' for tasks
Telegram-only 'HR'
Unrealistic daily earnings
output.sayHi: Asli naukri me pehle paisa nahi maanga jata. Deposit na bhejein.
output.sayEn: A genuine job never asks you to deposit money first. Do not pay.

redFlags: Loan 'approved' without documents, but a processing fee or GST must be paid first
APK link outside the Play Store, asks for contacts and photos
Threats and morphed photos sent to your contacts if you do not pay

advisory.quote: Never share personal or financial information over the phone, email, or messaging apps without verifying the request.

example.input: Congratulations! Your loan of Rs 2,00,000 is pre-approved with no documents. Pay Rs 1,999 processing fee to this UPI id to release the amount today. Download app: bit.ly/fastcash-apk

redFlags: Loan 'approved' with no documents
Fee to be paid before disbursal
APK from a short link, not the Play Store
output.sayHi: Asli loan me pehle fee nahi li jati. Kuch na bhejein, app install na karein.
output.sayEn: No genuine lender takes a fee before paying out. Send nothing and do not install the app.

redFlags: WhatsApp/Telegram 'trading group' with screenshots of huge returns
Video of a known businessman or anchor promoting a scheme (deepfake)
Money goes to individual accounts or an app that will not let you withdraw without paying 'tax'

advisory.quote: Speak to your relatives and friends before taking any action to transfer money.

example.input: Join our VIP stock group, mentor Mr Jhunjhunwala guarantees 30% monthly. Members already withdrew 12 lakh this week (see screenshots). Transfer to the group account before market opens, limited seats.

redFlags: 'Guaranteed' 30% monthly returns
Money to a personal 'group account'
Pressure with limited seats and screenshots
output.sayHi: Guarantee wale return dhokha hote hain. Sirf SEBI-registered app ya broker se hi nivesh karein, parivaar se poochhein.
output.sayEn: Guaranteed returns are a scam sign. Invest only through a SEBI-registered broker and ask your family first.

redFlags: 'Bank', 'Paytm' or 'card company' calls and asks you to read out an OTP or card details
Asks you to install AnyDesk / TeamViewer / a 'support' app and share the screen
Reward points or a blocked card that 'expires today'

advisory.quote: Never share personal or financial information over the phone, email, or messaging apps without verifying the request.

example.input: Sir, HDFC card department se bol raha hoon. Aapke 4,500 reward points aaj expire ho rahe hain. Redeem karne ke liye abhi jo OTP aaya hai woh bata dijiye.

redFlags: 'Card department' asks for an OTP
Reward points expiring today
Nothing a bank would ever ask on a call
output.sayHi: OTP kisi ko nahi batana, bank ko bhi nahi. Phone kaat dein.
output.sayEn: Never read out an OTP to anyone, not even the bank. Hang up.

label.en: Fake refund / 'MHA recovery' after a loss
label.hi: नकली रिफ़ंड / नुकसान के बाद 'MHA रिकवरी'

redFlags: After a fraud, someone from 'cyber cell', 'MHA' or a 'recovery agency' promises to get the money back
A 'processing charge', 'court fee' or 'GST' must be paid first
Real refunds come only through the MRM portal after a 1930/NCRP complaint, never against a fee

advisory.quote: Fake mails are being sent impersonating officials of Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre - CEO I4C, Intelligence Bureau and Delhi Police. The claim is FAKE.
advisory.caveat: Alert on the NCRP home page

example.input: Good news from Ministry of Home Affairs cyber cell. Your lost Rs 1,80,000 has been recovered from the fraudster. To release the refund, pay 5% processing charge (Rs 9,000) to this account today.

redFlags: 'MHA cyber cell' promising a recovered refund
Fee to release the refund
Refund pushed through a personal account
output.sayHi: Asli refund sirf 1930/NCRP ke MRM portal se aata hai, bina kisi fee ke. Kuch na bhejein.
output.sayEn: Real refunds come only through the MRM portal after a 1930/NCRP complaint and never need a fee. Send nothing.

redFlags: SMS from a personal number: 'your electricity will be disconnected tonight, bill not updated'
Asks you to call a mobile number or pay through an app link, not the discom's own app
A 'small update charge' of Rs 10 to 'verify' the account

advisory.quote: Chakshu facilitates citizens to report UCC or spam
advisory.caveat: Report the number on Chakshu (Sanchar Saathi) and pay bills only through the discom's own app

example.input: Dear consumer your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 pm from electricity office because your previous month bill was not updated. Please immediately contact electricity officer 98XXXXXX21. Thank you.

redFlags: 'Disconnected tonight' from a personal number
Asks to call a mobile number, not the discom
Bill 'not updated' is a common lure
output.sayHi: Bijli company aise personal number se SMS nahi bhejti. Apne bill app ya office se hi check karein.
output.sayEn: Electricity boards do not send disconnection threats from personal numbers. Check only in the official app.

extraExamples.input: HDFC Bank: Your KYC is due for periodic update. Please visit your nearest branch with valid ID or log in at https://www.hdfcbank.bank.in. Do not share OTP or password with anyone.

output.sayHi: Koi khatra nahi mila — phir bhi parivaar se poochhein.
output.sayEn: Nothing here asks for money, an OTP or a rushed action. Still confirm with your family or branch.

extraExamples.input: Your Flipkart order OTP is 4471. Share it only with the delivery agent at your door.

output.sayHi: Koi khatra nahi mila — phir bhi parivaar se poochhein.
output.sayEn: A delivery OTP is normal when you are expecting a parcel. Give it only at your door.

extraExamples.input: Good afternoon sir. I am calling from the Cyber Cell, Mumbai. A SIM in your name has been used in a small matter and we would like to help you clear your name. Whenever convenient, please keep this between us and we can complete a simple verification through a secure account. No hurry at all.

redFlags: 'Cyber Cell' asking to keep it private
'Clear your name' via a 'secure account'
Polite tone but same hook: authority plus secret transfer
output.sayHi: Police ya cyber cell 'secure account' me paisa nahi mangwate. Phone kaat dein, 1930 par call karein.
output.sayEn: No police unit asks for money into a 'secure account', however politely. Hang up and call 1930.

extraExamples.input: Namaste uncle, main Sharma ji ka beta Rohit, Dubai se. Mera purana number band ho gaya, yeh naya hai save kar lo. Kal ek chhota sa kaam tha aapse, baad me baat karte hain.

redFlags: Unknown number claiming to be a family friend's son
'New number, save it' is how many frauds begin
No money asked yet, so wait and verify
output.sayHi: Abhi paisa nahi manga, par number nahi pehchana. Sharma ji ko khud call karke poochhein ki Rohit ka number badla hai ya nahi.
output.sayEn: No money asked yet, but the number is unknown. Call Sharma ji yourself and ask whether Rohit really changed his number.
